metadata_rows.description: len(metadata) for the tiny metadata table.

observation_rows.description: len(observations) for the tiny observations table.

unique_objects.description: metadata['object_id'].nunique() from the tiny metadata table, not observations.

passbands.description: Sorted unique integer values in observations['passband'].

target_classes.description: Sorted unique integer values in metadata['target'].

detected_fraction.description: Rows with detected == 1 divided by all observation rows; no rows are dropped.

negative_flux_fraction.description: Rows with flux < 0, strictly, divided by all observation rows; zero is not negative and no rows are dropped.

anchor_object.selection_criteria: Within the completed tiny subset: target == 90, all six passbands; prefer at least 40 observations and 20 detected rows; then rank by detected rows descending, total rows descending, and object_id ascending.
anchor_object.description: Well-sampled target-90 Type Ia supernova selected by the documented anchor rule.
